cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You remember how I taught you to wrap them separately so there's always one left?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered the route without asking me this time. Take the flask too, sweetheart; then you can stay as long as you need.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then come here before you go. Let me tuck a napkin beside the last sandwich, the way I always did for you. Promise you'll eat it even when I'm not there to remind you.
